name: mjsk-markdown-checkboxes
description: Adds checkbox support to the built-in markdown preview

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.enableTableChec.markdownDescription: Enable parsing `[ ]`, `[x]`, `[~]`, and `[-]` checkboxes inside tables in the markdown preview. When disabled, checkbox parsing stays list-only (GitHub-style `- [ ]`).

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.enableExtendedS.markdownDescription: Enable rendering (and optional persistence toggling) for extended checkbox states `[~]` and `[-]`.

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.persistPreviewC.markdownDescription: When enabled, clicking a checkbox in the markdown preview updates the source file. Requires VS Code setting `markdown.preview.allowCommandLinks` to be enabled to allow preview command links.

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.persistPreviewT.markdownDescription: Optional ordered list of checkbox states to cycle through when `#mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.persistPreviewChanges#` is enabled. If empty, uses the default toggle behavior. Example: `["unchecked", "wip", "checked", "cancelled"]`.

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.label.markdownDescription: Wrap the rendered list items in a `<label>` element.

mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.labelAfter.markdownDescription: Adds the label after the checkbox. Only applies when `#mjsk-markdown-checkboxes.label#` is set to `true`.

scripts.compile: npm run package && npm run package-web && npm run build-notebook
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run package && npm run package-web && npm run build-notebook
